pool.sol: By Wilson's Theorem, \( 58! \equiv -1 \pmod{59} \). Factoring out the top \( 1 \) terms gives \( 58! = (58) \cdot 57! \equiv (-1)^{1} 1! \cdot 57! \equiv -1 \pmod{59} \). Inverting modulo \( 59 \) yields \( 57! \equiv 1 \pmod{59} \).

Replace \( 58, \dots \) with \( -1, -2, \dots \pmod{59} \) to isolate \( 57! \).
Invert the small factorial coefficient modulo \( 59 \) to obtain \( 1 \).
